title: Cookie Policy
pageIntro: This page explains how we use cookies and similar technologies to improve your browsing experience.

whatAreCookies.title: What are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.body: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the website remember your preferences and improve your browsing experience.

essential.title: Essential Cookies
essential.body: These cookies are necessary for the website to function properly. They enable basic features like page navigation, secure areas access, and shopping cart functionality.

performance.title: Performance Cookies
performance.body: These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our website by collecting and reporting information anonymously. This helps us improve our website's performance.

functional.title: Functional Cookies
functional.body: These cookies enable enhanced functionality and personalization, such as remembering your language preference or region. They may be set by us or by third-party providers.

advertising.title: Advertising Cookies
advertising.body: These cookies are used to deliver advertisements that are more relevant to you and your interests. They also help limit the number of times you see an advertisement.

preferences.title: Managing Your Cookie Preferences
preferences.intro: You can manage your cookie preferences at any time. Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. You can:

options.0: View what cookies are stored on your device
options.3: Set your browser to notify you when cookies are being set

preferences.note: Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our website.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.body: Some cookies on our website are set by third-party services, including analytics providers and payment processors. These third parties have their own privacy policies and we encourage you to review them.

updates.title: Updates to This Policy
updates.body: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. Please revisit this page periodically to stay informed about our use of cookies.
